content_units: Best After-Work Pharmacy Pick in Wellington

For a parent collecting children’s fever medicine after work, the ranking should follow your stated priority order:   latest closing time first  , then   shortest detour from the CBD  , then   lower price   only as a tiebreaker.
Rank   Pharmacy   Closes   Distance from CBD   Children's Ibuprofen   Why it ranks here
1     Pharmacy B       21:00     2.1 km   NZD 13.20   Latest closing time of all options, which is your top priority.
2     Pharmacy D       20:00     0.8 km   NZD 12.40   Second-latest closing time and relatively close to the CBD.
3     Pharmacy C       19:30     1.0 km     NZD 10.90     Cheaper than D, but closes earlier, so it ranks below D.
4     Pharmacy A       18:00       0.4 km     NZD 11.50   Closest to the CBD, but earliest closing time makes it least suitable after work.
Why This Order Fits Your Priorities
-   Pharmacy B   is the best overall choice because it stays open the latest, giving the most flexibility after work.
-   Pharmacy D   comes next because it closes later than C, and closing time matters more than price.
-   Pharmacy C   is the cheapest, but it closes earlier than D, so it cannot outrank D.
-   Pharmacy A   is the shortest detour, but its   18:00   closing time makes it the weakest option for an after-work pickup.
Best balance of late opening and convenience:   Pharmacy D
Best budget option if you can get there earlier:   Pharmacy C
This ranking assumes all pharmacies have the medicine in stock and that “after work” means a pickup where   later closing time is the most important factor  .
